opportunities.title: Patched Monday, Pwned by Friday: Citrix NetScaler Zero-Day Hits Boxes That Were Already Updated
opportunities.why_now: Active exploitation confirmed on NetScaler SAML zero-day even on appliances patched 'days earlier,' per SecurityWeek and BleepingComputer reporting from Oct 4-5.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence postmortem: build a timeline of disclosure→patch→exploit to show the shrinking window defenders actually have.

opportunities.title: Warlock Ransomware Turns SharePoint's Own Bugs Into an EDR Kill Switch
opportunities.why_now: Dark Reading and The Hacker News both report Warlock chaining SharePoint flaws to blind security tools right before detonating ransomware.
opportunities.angle: Kill-chain breakdown piece: map the exact flaw-to-ransomware sequence so readers can hunt for the IOCs in their own environment.

opportunities.title: ShinyHunters' Alleged Ringleader Nabbed in Jordan — Does the Breach Factory Shut Down?
opportunities.why_now: Multiple outlets (SecurityWeek, Hacker News, BleepingComputer) confirm the alleged ShinyHunters leader 'Rey' detained and reportedly cooperating with the FBI.
opportunities.angle: Threat-actor retrospective/explainer: tally the group's breach toll to date and assess whether the arrest actually disrupts the crew's extortion pipeline.

opportunities.title: GitLab's 9.9 AI Gateway Flaw: One Unauthenticated Request, Full Command Execution
opportunities.why_now: GitLab just patched a near-max-severity (9.9) AI Gateway vulnerability enabling command execution on self-hosted servers.
opportunities.angle: CVE spotlight with urgency framing — who's exposed, what the exploit path looks like, and a hard patch-now deadline for self-hosted admins.

opportunities.title: SWIFT's Banking Middleware Has an RCE Hole — and No Bank Gets to Opt Out
opportunities.why_now: Dark Reading reports a fresh RCE in SWIFT-adjacent banking/government middleware, a target too systemically critical to ignore.
opportunities.angle: Critical-infrastructure risk explainer: why financial middleware bugs are worse than typical CVEs and what incident response looks like when SWIFT-adjacent systems are in scope.
